description: Direct-to-storage LMS asset upload, step 3 of 3. Requires idempotencyKey so a response-timeout retry replays one durable receipt. The server independently verifies what storage holds (observed length, streamed SHA-256, container signature) before committing READY; the optional expectedSha256 is a cross-check only. A duplicate finalize returns the original READY asset. A verification mismatch fails the reservation closed (object removed) — retry with a fresh prepare and key.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_lms_finalize_asset_upload
